description.value: The Savona Library is a small branch of the Thompson-Nicola Regional Library, built in 2005 to replace a decades-old bookmobile stop in this tiny community on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor west of Kamloops. At 1,400 square feet it is a modest but fully functional public library offering free Wi-Fi, public computers, and printing. For a cyclist passing through rural Savona, it represents one of very few public indoor stops between Kamloops and Cache Creek.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and confirms the library's address (60 Savona Street, Box 169, Savona, BC V0K 2J0), phone (250-373-2666), and email (savlib@tnrd.ca), all consistent with OSM tags. The services section explicitly lists 'Wi-Fi' and 'Wheelchair accessible' and 'Public Computers', but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water access, or any other cycling-specific amenities — those are left null per the absence-of-evidence rule. The library is confirmed open with current branch contact and hours listed.
concerns: Website address includes 'Box 169' (PO Box) not present in OSM address field — same physical location but OSM record is slightly incomplete.
No washroom, water, or bike parking information appears anywhere on the website; all three required criteria are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate public facility in a genuinely isolated rural community on a major cycling route, and free Wi-Fi is confirmed. However, none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website, making it difficult to certify as cyclist-friendly without an on-the-ground visit or further evidence.
enrichment_extras.notes: Savona is a very small community; this library may be one of the only public facilities available to cyclists in the area. A field visit or staff inquiry to confirm washroom and bike parking availability would resolve the needs_review status.

blurb: Savona's small library at the west end of Kamloops Lake.
